s: Smartphones and related portable devices have emerged as the preferred vehicle connecting the digital world, such that today there are more than 20 billion connected devices and machine learning and artificial intelligence will continue to accelerate this trend.

New applications requiring massive data manipulation are emerging continually, such as autonomous cars, virtual reality, smart homes, tele-medicine, genomics, artificial intelligence and machine learning.
